summary_en: RECOMM completed a simplified share exchange on November 9, 2026, acquiring the remaining 45 shares of RECOMM IE Partner (RIE) held by Hikari Tsushin. RECOMM issued 920,188 treasury shares to Hikari Tsushin in exchange, making RIE a 100% subsidiary. No new shares were issued, avoiding dilution.
title_en: Notice Regarding Completion of Full Subsidiary Status of RECOMM IE Partner Co., Ltd., a Consolidated Subsidiary, through Share Exchange (Simplified Share Exchange) (Effectiveness of Share Exchange)
translation_en_brief:
RECOMM Co., Ltd. completed a simplified share exchange on November 9, 2026, acquiring all remaining shares of RECOMM IE Partner Co., Ltd. (RIE), which had been a consolidated subsidiary. The exchange involved RIE receiving 920,188 treasury shares held by RECOMM in exchange for 45 ordinary shares held by Hikari Tsushin, the previous minority shareholder. Following the transaction, RIE became a 100% subsidiary with voting control of 147 shares remaining in circulation after prior cancellations.

RIE had executed a preliminary acquisition of 53 shares from Hikari Tsushin on October 26, 2026, using cash consideration, which were immediately cancelled on October 27. This reduced Hikari Tsushin's remaining holdings to 45 shares, which became the subject of the exchange. The simplified procedure was employed under the Companies Act Article 796(2), requiring no shareholder approval for RECOMM and avoiding dilution since only treasury shares were issued.

The transaction was accounted for as a capital transaction under IFRS 10, with no goodwill recognized. The difference between acquisition cost and the carrying amount of the minority interest was recorded directly in equity, with no impact on consolidated profit or loss. As RIE was already a consolidated subsidiary, the completion is expected to have minimal effect on RECOMM's consolidated results for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027.
